items.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996
items.q: But that night I sang like Wynonie Harris.

ctx.x: Did you have aspirations at that time, when you were in the Merchant Marine, to be a singer?
I was trying to sing like the Ink Spots then. But that night I sang like Wynonie Harris. blues.
They must have liked you, huh?
